reason: The commit only tightens eXIf chunk validation and fixes internal data-pointer setup while parsing chunks after IDAT. The existing harness already supplies arbitrary PNG bytes through spng_set_png_buffer() and exercises the complete decode path through spng_decoded_image_size() and spng_decode_image(), so it can reach both changed parsing paths without new API calls, initialization, configuration, state, or input construction.
evidence: get_ancillary_data_first_idat() and validate_past_idat() now reject a zero-length eXIf chunk with SPNG_EEXIF.
validate_past_idat() now assigns data = ctx->data before read_chunk_bytes() and subsequent ancillary-chunk processing.
The harness passes the entire fuzz input to spng_set_png_buffer(ctx, (void*)data, size).
The harness invokes spng_decoded_image_size() and spng_decode_image(), which are the existing high-level PNG parsing and decoding path.
No new entry point, feature flag, API protocol, initialization requirement, configuration option, or input constraint is introduced.
recommended_action: Keep the existing fuzz harness unchanged; no maintenance is required for this commit.
